summaries.Romania: Romania faced three Russian drone incursions in consecutive days, with F-16s successfully intercepting all three, prompting diplomatic protests and NATO solidarity. Concurrent weather threats and healthcare capacity concerns underscore the nation's multi-front challenges.
summaries.Healthcare: OpenAI expands consumer health capabilities while payers struggle with marketplace economics; innovation in endometriosis screening and rural care models alongside persistent challenges in prior authorization and drug pricing dominate the sector.
summaries.Tech: Apple ecosystem faces pricing pressures and foldable competition as Samsung advances; meanwhile, AI infrastructure strains and data center reliability emerge as critical challenges for the broader tech industry.

items.title: iPhone 18 won’t debut this fall, here’s why
items.snippet: We’re about two months away from Apple’s annual iPhone debut in September. This year, though, will be a bit different. Instead of the entire iPhone lineup debuting at once, only the iPhone 18 Pro, iPhone 18 Pro Max, and all-new foldable iPhone will launch this September. Here’s why.
items.line: iPhone 18 launch strategy shifts to September reveal of Pro models and foldable only, with standard models delayed to later release.

items.title: Google basically confirms the Pixel 11 is getting a price hike
